questions.question: What does the preprocessor do?
questions.explanation: Directives transform source text; compiler sees the result.

questions.question: BAD(2,3)*10 gives 2 because?
questions.explanation: Unparenthesized bodies rebind with surrounding operators.

questions.question: Two-step STR needed because?
options: Single # pastes the literal tokens without expanding macros
questions.explanation: Helper forces argument expansion before stringizing.

questions.question: -DNDEBUG removes LOG because?
options: LOG defined to nothing under that flag at compile time
questions.explanation: The call never exists in the release translation unit.

questions.question: Freestanding removes what?
questions.explanation: You keep syntax+types; you provide entry, I/O, memory.

questions.question: bare.c compiles -ffreestanding -nostdlib -c but can't run. Why?
options: No entry/startup/link layout until boot.s + linker script provide them
questions.explanation: Compile checks language; running needs the kernel half (Tooling 02).
